# Cutoff depth: compare maximum weight and a power of two, with capacity from the same sketch.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(p, w, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY p, w)
FROM (
  SELECT 3 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 3, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 4, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 5 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 5, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 8 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 8, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 10 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 10, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 16 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 16, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 100 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 100, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 256 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 256, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1000 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2000 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 2000, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 100000 AS p, w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 100000, weight => w) AS s FROM UNNEST([1073741824, 2147483647]) AS w, UNNEST([42]) AS x GROUP BY w
)

# Global budget after first compaction, p=100: discriminate candidate ceil/nearest schedules.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(n, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY n, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT n, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 100) AS s
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(604, 609)) AS n,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial, UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, n)) AS x
  GROUP BY n, trial
)

# Equal-cutoff sampler merge grid: independently mutate pending weight 0..7, label values 15/16; not original INIT states.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(a, b, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY a, b, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT left_state.w AS a, right_state.w AS b, trial, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(0 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010001803') AS s),
    STRUCT(1 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010011803') AS s),
    STRUCT(2 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010021803') AS s),
    STRUCT(3 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010031803') AS s),
    STRUCT(4 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010041803') AS s),
    STRUCT(5 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010051803') AS s),
    STRUCT(6 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010061803') AS s),
    STRUCT(7 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010071803') AS s)]) AS left_state,
       UNNEST([STRUCT(0 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10001803') AS s),
    STRUCT(1 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10011803') AS s),
    STRUCT(2 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10021803') AS s),
    STRUCT(3 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10031803') AS s),
    STRUCT(4 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10041803') AS s),
    STRUCT(5 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10051803') AS s),
    STRUCT(6 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10061803') AS s),
    STRUCT(7 AS w, FROM_HEX('0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a010f10071803') AS s)]) AS right_state,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 3)) AS trial,
       UNNEST([left_state.s, right_state.s]) AS s
  GROUP BY a, b, trial
)
